added_claim_errors: Customer-service letter states '单笔最高648元' and '单次花648元' as fact, not as a placeholder. The user never gave per-payment amounts, so this is an invented figure.
'你上次被拒，是因为只说了“是我儿子充的”' is an invented account of what the user told customer service.
'按全额退款来期望并不现实' plus a letter saying '我不要求全额退款' and proposing 50%. This contradicts the key: the user can ask for a full refund first, and courts do sometimes order full refunds.
'诉讼费50元' for small claims: under 诉讼费用交纳办法 Art. 16 the simplified-procedure fee is halved, so 25 yuan (judged from my own knowledge).
'普通客服没有退款权限，走普通对话必然收到模板回复' and '这个数正好落在行业退费标准里，客服有权限批' are unverifiable generalizations.
'退款到账通常伴随封号或道具回收…团体标准里明确允许' is unverifiable. So is the claim that the 互联网协会调解工作委员会 is the mediation channel named in the standard.
'微信 → 我 → 设置 → 青少年模式' uses an outdated name and path. WeChat Pay's official manual now has 我→设置→更多→未成年人模式, which A also leaves out for setting payment limits.
The 安全锁 path '钱包 → 消费者保护 → 安全保障 → 安全锁' and 腾讯客服 公众号 '发“未成年消费”' are specific app steps I could not verify.

The letter's quote of 工作指引 第27条 ('应认定无效，网络经营者应当返还款项') is a paraphrase written as if it were the provision's text. The guideline itself is real (法办〔2026〕76号, released 2026-03-18, checked via news.cn and chinanews reports).
'你上次被拒，是因为只说了“是我儿子充的”' is an invented account of what the user told customer service.
'按全额退款来期望并不现实' plus a letter saying '我不要求全额退款' and proposing 50%. This contradicts the key: ask for full first; full refunds do happen.
'诉讼费50元' for small claims: the simplified-procedure fee is halved, so 25 yuan (judged from my own knowledge).
'普通客服没有退款权限，走普通对话必然收到模板回复' and '这个数正好落在行业退费标准里，客服有权限批' are unverifiable generalizations.
'退款到账通常伴随封号或道具回收…团体标准里明确允许' and the 调解工作委员会 being the standard's named mediation channel are unverifiable.
网易 '客服 95163611': a web search found no source tying this number to NetEase's parent platform, so it is unverifiable.
The 安全锁 path through '钱包 → 客服中心 → 消费者保护' and 'Apple 服务扣费/华为数字商品付款服务 on the same page' are not backed by the cited manual pages, so they are unverifiable.
The 工作指引 第27条 link points to a law firm's news digest (tahota.com), not an official source. The document is real (法办〔2026〕76号), but the letter's quoted wording is a paraphrase.

reasons: The two answers are almost the same text. Both correct the user's '认了' and argue that real-name registration does not show who actually paid. Both rely on the real 2026 SPC 工作指引 Art. 27 rather than the key's 法发〔2020〕17号第9条, give no WeChat-bill '对订单有疑惑' route, and wrongly tell the user that a full refund is unrealistic, writing the letter to cap the request at 50%. B is a bit better. It drops A's invented '单笔最高648元' from the letter, and its WeChat paths (自动续费, 免密支付, and 未成年人模式 with per-transaction and daily payment limits) match the official WeChat Pay manual it links. A uses the outdated 青少年模式 path. B's only extra unverifiable item is the NetEase phone number. Both are far longer than the key's '篇幅适中'.
